newsitem.title: SWEDEN: SAS says cuts Sweden domestic summer fare.
newsitem.headline: SAS says cuts Sweden domestic summer fare.

text.p: Scandinavian airline SAS said on Wednesday that it would cut domestic fares in Sweden over the 1997 summer.
SAS said prices would be cut from June 23 to August 10 with fares trimmed by 250 crowns compared to the lowest ordinary price, the SAS Jackpot Mini.
"We are following up last year's summer success of free travel for children," SAS Domestic in Sweden said in a statement.
"This year the offer is even better because even adult prices are reduced. We hope this will attract a lot of new passengers."
The new fares would price return flights between Stockholm/Gothenburg and Stockholm-Malmo at 800 crowns and Stockholm-Karlstad 700 crowns.
